title: WOLF V1.2 actuator — real STEP assembly
author: Anthrobotics and WOLF actuator contributors
derivatives: Original STEP, upstream README, license and assembly guide are byte-identical. Display derivatives must preserve source graph/placement and identify all presentation changes; source and derived model assets remain CC-BY-SA-4.0.
sourceNotes: Source has 184 explicit metre geometry contexts and AP242 schema. OCCT normalizes geometry and placement to millimetres, and the display applies its metre/Y-up mapping exactly once; original source units and bytes remain unchanged.
The V1.2 upstream README directs readers to the included V1.1 assembly guide.
Twelve individually named planet definitions are retained. Generic Part N, cc and magnet names remain as provided; names are not upgraded into inferred component semantics.
STEP placements are source data, not recovered mates or validated kinematic constraints.

69 bearing definitions contain embedded source triangulated faces without analytic surfaces and occur twice each. Their original face geometry is preserved, analytic bounds remain null, and analytic-geometry coverage is explicitly limited.
upstreamAttribution: Upstream credits the RFX gearbox by Robin Fröjd as design inspiration.
